title: From estimate to an agreed invoice
description: The chosen work package carries on into the document with no retyping.

blocks.text: Several separate estimates make comparison harder and leave the question of which option was approved.

quote.text: App is great just would be better if there was a way to add different options to estimates. For example different options for the customer to select on the estimate. I do HVAC and to send 3 different estimates is a pain.

blocks.text: Show the options in one conversation, record the version that was chosen and carry its lines into the invoice. Write up extra work separately.
A new template or price shouldn’t change a document that has already been agreed.
